ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity pixels relative to low-intensity pixels, with white pixels concentrated primarily at the distal tips and lower margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous low-intensity (black) region covering approximately 92% of the visible surface; discrete white speckling and mottling mapped to the lower ventral edge near the water interface and at both distal extremities.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 75 degrees and a bounding-box depth of roughly 12% of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels; frequent small jagged peaks observed across both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex sweep from the median notch that transitions into a jagged, non-linear trajectory at the terminal ends of the fluke.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, irregular white/grey pixel clusters (30-50 pixel diameter) localized on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single prominent white linear pixel disruption detected on the upper-mid region of the left lobe, oriented at a diagonal trajectory toward the notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe jagged irregularity and tissue loss at the terminal tips of both lobes, consistent with significant barnacle colonization or previous physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Fine-grained white spotting pattern (stardust-like distribution) concentrated along the ventral boundary where the fluke intersects the waterline.
